title: v2.1.280
content: What's changed Added Claude Opus 5.5 ( claude-opus-5-5 ), now the default Opus model — 1M context, $4/$20 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads Added mouse support to more lists in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the /skills list, and a skill's state options in /plugin can be clicked Added CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH to change the 2,048-character cap on MCP tool descriptions and server instructions for every MCP server in the session Added hook output sizes and the number of oversized outputs saved to a file to the hook_execution_complete OpenTelemetry event Fixed writes through a symlinked path being judged by their in-tree spelling: the prompt names where the write lands, and acceptEdits , allow rules and auto mode no longer approve one landing outside Fixed auto mode retrying an action over and over when a safety check declined to review it; the action is now denied once, noting that retrying won't help Fixed auto mode denying actions over and over without pause when a
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.280 新增 Claude Opus 5.5（claude-opus-5-5），并设为默认 Opus 模型。它支持 1M 上下文，价格为每百万 token 输入 $4、输出 $20，缓存读取 $0.20。本版还新增了 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_MCP_DESCRIPTION_LENGTH 环境变量，用于调整 MCP 工具描述的长度上限；全屏模式下更多列表支持鼠标操作；hook 相关的 OpenTelemetry 事件也增加了输出大小指标。安全方面，修复了通过符号链接路径写入时的权限判定问题，acceptEdits、allow 规则和 auto 模式不会再放行实际落在项目目录外的写入。
pin_reason: Opus 5.5 成为 Claude Code 的默认模型，同时公布了 1M 上下文和新定价，是影响所有用户的重要版本。

title: ScienceSep 4, 2026Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem We are sharing the first complete computer-checked proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Claude worked largely autonomously over 11 days to write the proof in the Lean programming language.
content: ScienceSep 4, 2026Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem We are sharing the first complete computer-checked proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Claude worked largely autonomously over 11 days to write the proof in the Lean programming language.
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布了首个完整的费马大定理计算机验证证明。这份证明由 Claude 用 Lean 语言写成，基本自主地连续工作了 11 天。这说明大模型已经能独立完成长时间、高难度的形式化编程任务，也为 AI 自主编程和长任务 Agent 工作流提供了一个里程碑级的参考。
pin_reason: 这是 Claude 首次基本自主完成费马大定理的完整形式化证明，是 AI 长时间自主编程能力的里程碑。

title: v2.1.285
content: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH environment variable to turn off the WebFetch tool Added claude --desktop to open the Claude desktop app on the current directory, or on a session with --continue / --resume <id> Added claude plugin configure <plugin> to show a plugin's options and which are unset, or save new values read from stdin with --values-stdin Added <server>.<key>=<value> to claude plugin install --config , so a bundled .mcpb MCP server's own settings can be set at install time and it starts without visiting /plugin → Configure Added allowedProviders managed setting to limit which API providers a machine may use (Anthropic API, a custom endpoint, Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex AI, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, or a Cloud gateway) Added CLAUDE_CODE_NONSTREAMING_TIMEOUT_RETRIES environment variable to cap re-sends of a non-streaming fallback request that timed out Fixed claude -p with CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=1 : a subagent's own Agent call now runs in the foregrou
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.285 新增了一批配置和管控能力：可用 CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH 关闭 WebFetch 工具，可用 claude --desktop 在当前目录或指定会话中打开桌面端。插件方面，新增 claude plugin configure 命令，安装插件时还能用 --config 直接写入内置 .mcpb MCP 服务器的配置。企业可以通过 allowedProviders 托管设置限制机器能用哪些 API 提供商，这对团队统一管理和自动化部署很有用。

title: feat(pi): curated pi/core skills+prompts profile, CI load test, and 2…
content:
feat(pi): curated pi/core skills+prompts profile, CI load test, and 2.2.2 release sync (#3264)

Adds a curated, Pi-native, skills+prompts-only profile at pi/core/ for downstream packagers that mirror GitHub Releases.

- manifests/pi-core.json: explicit include lists, per-item exclusion reasons, curation rules, safety allowlists; every root skill and command must be classified.
- scripts/build-pi-core.js regenerates pi/core deterministically (package.json from VERSION, LICENSE, README.md, CURATION.md, skills/, commands/); --check fails CI on drift. council is renamed ecc-council inside pi/core only.
- Safety checks: no callable endpoints outside the allowlist, no npx/curl|sh/pip install, no secrets, no absolute home paths, no symlinks, valid frontmatter, no duplicate names.
- CI: build + drift check and an offline Pi CLI load test of pi/core.
- Release: VERSION, package.json and pi/core/package.json at 2.2.2, CHANGELOG, tag-triggered release verification, and a two-week cadence in CONTR
author: affaan-m
summary_zh: everything-claude-code 仓库这次提交新增了面向 Pi 的精选配置 pi/core。它只收录 skills 和 prompts，靠 manifest 明确列出包含项和排除理由，并由脚本确定性生成。提交还加了多项安全检查：禁止 npx 或 curl|sh 这类安装命令、禁止密钥和绝对路径、校验 frontmatter，并在 CI 里检测生成结果是否漂移，可以作为 skills 分发和打包治理的参考。

title: Quoting Anthropic Frontier Red Team
content: We evaluate several models on 100 tasks from the [internal Binary Exploitation benchmark] (selected at random), and find that GLM-5.3 develops full control flow hijacks in 4% of the trials; Claude Mythos Preview did so in 6%. Although GLM-5.3 performs below Claude Mythos Preview here, a meaningful threshold has clearly been crossed: earlier models, like Claude Opus 4.6 and GLM-5.2, do not succeed in any of them. — Anthropic Frontier Red Team , GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities Tags: anthropic , generative-ai , ai-security-research , glm , ai , ai-in-china , llms
summary_zh: Anthropic 前沿红队的评估显示，在内部二进制漏洞利用基准的 100 个任务中，GLM-5.3 有 4% 的试验能完成完整的控制流劫持，Claude Mythos Preview 为 6%。Claude Opus 4.6、GLM-5.2 等早期模型一次都没成功。这说明高级网络攻击能力已越过关键门槛，并开始向中国开源模型扩散。内容主要是模型能力与 AI 安全方面的洞察，和 Claude Code 的具体使用关系不大。

title: What Jev Means for AI Agent Security. The Security Gamble Behind “Jev Can’t Hallucinate”.
content: A CISSP's field guide to using Jev, TypeSafe's System One model, in AI agent security: where cheap AI judgment fits, stops, and what attackers will target.
author: Karo (Product with Attitude)
summary_zh: 文章由一位 CISSP 安全专家撰写，是在 AI Agent 安全场景中使用 TypeSafe 的 System One 模型 Jev 的实战指南。文章分析了这类低成本 AI 判断适合用在哪些环节、在哪里会失效，并提醒不要轻信“Jev 不会幻觉”的说法，同时列出了攻击者可能针对的薄弱点。内容与 Claude Code 没有直接关系，但对设计 Agent 安全防护有一定参考价值。

title: Update claude-api skill: link refusal billing to the docs (#1825)
content:

Point each refusal billing sentence at the "How refusals are billed"
docs section instead of restating the rules in the skill.

Also correct two claims to match that section: a refusal before any
output counts against rate limits, and a mid-stream refusal bills
input tokens as well as the output already streamed.
author: cj-ant
summary_zh: anthropics/skills 仓库给 claude-api skill 做了一次更新。原来 skill 里自己写了一遍拒绝响应（refusal）的计费规则，现在改为直接链接到官方文档的「How refusals are billed」章节。同时改正了两处说法：一是模型在输出任何内容前就拒绝，也会占用速率限制额度；二是流式输出中途拒绝时，输入 token 和已经输出的 token 都要计费。

title: What Is Jev? Why Is Everyone Crazy About It? What I Built for Less Than $1.
content: LLMs talks through a problem. Jev makes a small, structured decisions. You can keep using Claude Code or Perplexity Computer and add Jev to the workflows you build with them.
author: Karo (Product with Attitude)
summary_zh: 文章介绍了新工具 Jev。它和擅长对话式推理的 LLM 不同，专门做小型、结构化的决策，可以嵌入到用 Claude Code 或 Perplexity Computer 搭建的工作流中。作者还分享了用不到 1 美元搭建应用的实践案例，不过目前提供的内容信息量较少，缺少具体实现细节。
